title: Microsoft Office SharePoint Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability

descriptions.value: Improper access control in CocktailBarService prior to SMR Oct-2026 Release 1 allows local attackers to access sensitive information.

In modem, there is a possible information disclosure due to missing filtering of sensitive data in crash dumps. This could lead to local information disclosure with no additional execution privileges needed.
